_meta.sample_rule: per deployment: E3-applied built ASVs, strata ['2', '3-4', '5-9', '>=10'], 10 per stratum by sha256('downstream_e3|'+asv); 5 n=1 controls likewise
_meta.environment: KBase complete medium (ModelSEEDDatabase Media/KBaseMedia.cpd), every compound at uptake 100; prFBA's carbon cap C <= 100

definitions.flux_gene_backed: sum |v| over rxn reactions with a GPR in the gapfilled model
definitions.flux_p_changed: sum |v| over rxn reactions whose p differs between k/n and E3
definitions.rerouted_share: sum_rxn |v_e3 - v_kn| / (sum_rxn |v_kn| + sum_rxn |v_e3|): 0 identical, 1 disjoint supports
definitions.pooled_share_rerouted: the same ratio with numerator and denominator summed over genomes
definitions.objective: value of prFBA's weighted minimisation (each arm priced with its own p)
